classification.difficultyReason: Identify observations separated from the main cluster in dot plots and histograms, reporting an interval when grouped data do not show an exact value.

content.prompt: Circle the outlier in these datasets.

spec.description: Stacked blue dots with black outlines, horizontal gridlines and arrowed axes. Filled point markers represent observations.
spec.mathematics: Frequencies: 1:4, 2:6, 3:5, 4:5, 5:4, 10:1. Horizontal labels 1–10; Frequency labels 0–7. Horizontal grid spacing is 0.5 frequency units.
spec.answerVisibility: Student graph contains all observations and no answer marks.

answer.worked: $10$ is separated from the other observations, which lie from $1$ to $5$, so it is the outlier.

spec.description: Retains the source answer ring below 10 and circles the isolated observation.
spec.mathematics: The observation at (10,1) is the outlier.
